items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: Frankie Christian lived right next door to them. Frankie, I believe, was the one that was scheduled to go away with the original Dixon Land Band, wasn't he? I don't know.

ctx.x: So, were your family musical at all?

Well, to some extent, yes. My grandfather on my mother's side, his name was Schmidt. My name being Hug, family name. My mother's family name was Schmidt. My grandfather played French horn. My grandfather played French horn. And he traveled around with circus bands. In fact, he was hardly ever at home. Grandmother hardly ever got to see him. I understand that he did play with the Christians at one time. To what extent, I just don't know. But I know that the Christian family were neighbors of my grandmother and my…
I never could get that story.
